page.content:
Sogdian and later Timurid city on the Zeravshan.

How Samarkand connects

  • Location: Overland Silk Road — Samarkand is the Sogdian hinge of the overland road.
  • Faction: Sogdians — Samarkand was a chief Sogdian caravan city.
  • Item: Paper — Samarkand is the traditional first western paper center on the road.

What is Samarkand?

Samarkand was the great Sogdian caravan capital, then a Mongol ruin, then Timur's showcase. Silk, paper, and diplomats passed it on the way between China and Iran.

Key threads lead to Overland Silk Road, Sogdians and Paper.
